mcp:tool-listener.name: get_product_description
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Get the description of a Newell product in another language. Returns the description, the language code and the full language name.

raise-error.description: lang must be a two-letter ISO language code, for example FR.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { productId: (payload.productId default "") as String } ++ (if (!isEmpty(payload.lang default "")) { lang: upper(payload.lang as String) } else {})
